correctness.rationale: The weighted cycle vertex metric is the two-bit weighted Hamming metric. Assume a≥b and set R=(a^p+b^p)^(1/p). Below R, a ball can leave its own long-bit fiber only for a neighbor with unchanged short label. A long-bit fiber omitted by the three centers therefore receives at most three labels and cannot be covered. At R the proposed complementary pair in one fiber and a center in its opposite cover both occupied fibers and all short labels in the two remaining fibers; this works also at p=1. For a>b and p>1 an R-ball consists of its own fiber and one two-point line in each adjacent fiber. Any pair intersects: equal fibers share their full fiber; for adjacent fibers use one center's own full fiber and the other's line there (clarifying the intermediate-fiber wording at line 28); for opposite fibers the two lines in a common adjacent fiber are perpendicular. Two eight-point balls cannot cover. Three distinct occupied fibers leave perpendicular lines in the missing fiber; two adjacent occupied fibers would require at least two centers in each; one occupied fiber cannot reach its opposite. For two opposite occupied fibers the repeated short labels must differ in both bits, giving 4×2×4=32 triples. For a=b and p>1 balls are 3×3 toroidal neighborhoods and pairwise intersections have at least four points. The minimum-distance graph is Q4 and its isometries act by bit translations and coordinate permutations: a zero-fixing automorphism is determined by the four neighbors, since distance to those and zero recovers every support. True metric distances 2a and 2^(1/p)a distinguish paired directions among the two-bit displacements, leaving exactly 128 maps. The fresh exhaustive replay over all 560 triples yielded 96 equal-edge covers with orbits of 32 and 64 under those maps, and checked the unequal count and two-center exclusion. The analytic threshold reduction is separate from this replay; the frozen script was not executed. Finally a≤R<a+b for p>1 so the factor needs exactly two balls, whereas the product needs three.
